algorithm: Use two reachability states per source position: still moving right, or already moving left.
correctness_argument: Initialization allows any matching starting character. Each next target character moves a right-state one step right, or either state one step left into the permanent left phase. These transitions represent exactly paths with at most one right-to-left turn.
edge_cases: Turning back to the right is forbidden

steps.claim: After moving left the chip may switch back to moving right.
steps.rationale: After moving left the chip may switch back to moving right.
